description: Add in-game naira via GET/PUT /api/save (user-supplied amount). Always call session_status first; if not signed in, emit_display preview then input for login before this tool. Default 20000 if wallet_inflate_amount_ngn omitted; max applied 1000000000 per call (poc_free_wallet_topup.py). On STALE_SAVE, ask user to close Lagos tabs and call again. After success, report amount added and money_after.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

wallet_inflate_amount_ngn.description: Naira to add (default 20000 if omitted). Values above 1000000000 are clamped in poc_free_wallet_topup.py; explain the cap when amount_capped is true.

name: free_wallet_topup
